saving.w_sample: Sample, kept only while you look around
saving.w_sample_tip: Nothing here is your own work. Leave the sample and it is cleared
saving.w_ok: In this browser and your “{name}” folder
saving.w_ok_at: Every save goes to both. Last saved to the folder at {time}
saving.w_saving_tip: Your work is already in this browser
saving.w_ask: Only in this browser. “{name}” needs a click to reconnect
saving.w_ask_tip: Chrome needs your OK to use the folder again. Choose “Allow on every visit” and it won’t ask next time
saving.w_lost: Only in this browser. Can’t reach “{name}”
saving.w_full: Only in this browser. The disk with “{name}” is full
saving.w_room: Only in this browser. This browser is out of room, so “{name}” can’t catch up
saving.w_lost_tip: It’ll catch up by itself as soon as the folder is back

saving.w_decide.one: One thing to decide about your folder
saving.w_decide.other: {n} things to decide about your folder

saving.w_checking: Checking where your work is kept…
saving.w_drive: Backed up in your Google Drive
saving.w_drive_tip: Every change also goes to Grading Studio’s own hidden folder in your Google Drive
saving.w_none: Not backed up. Only in this browser
saving.w_none_tip: Clearing this browser’s data would erase your work. Choose a folder and every save goes there too
saving.w_none_nopick: Clearing this browser’s data would erase your work. This browser can’t save to a folder, so make a take-home file when you finish marking
saving.f_linked_about: A copy of your papers, marks, scores, comments, rosters and rubrics is kept here, with no save button to remember. If this browser is ever cleared, link the folder again and everything comes back.
saving.f_inside: It is in a folder called “{root}” inside “{name}”.
saving.f_about: Choose a folder on this computer once, and every save goes there as well as to this browser, with a copy of each day to go back to. Choose something private: it holds student work. When Chrome asks, choose “Allow on every visit”. If you already have a Grading Studio folder, choose it and your work comes back.
saving.f_stop_text: What’s already in the folder stays there. Nothing in it is deleted. Your work carries on in this browser, with no second copy.
saving.f_stopped: Not saving to a folder any more. The folder’s files are still there.
saving.f_bad: That folder couldn’t be used. Try another one.
saving.f_done: Done. Your work now saves to “{name}” as well.
saving.f_reopened: Newer work from your folder came in, so this download has been reopened.
saving.f_all_back: Everything came back from your folder.

saving.f_came.one: Newer work from your folder came in for one student.
saving.f_came.other: Newer work from your folder came in for {n} students.

saving.f_lost: Some files your folder lists aren’t in it any more, or are damaged, so they couldn’t come back. This affects: {list}. Your marks, scores and comments are all here. To get papers back, drop the same download in again.
saving.hist_about: The folder keeps a copy of each day, and one before anything big. Going back puts your marks, scores, comments, late files, readings, rosters and settings back to how they were then. Papers stay.
saving.hist_none: No copies in the folder yet. The first one is made today.
saving.hist_nofolder: Link a folder and it keeps a copy of each day to go back to.
saving.hist_q: Go back to this copy from {when}?
saving.hist_text: Your marks, scores, comments, late files, readings, rosters and settings go back to how they were then, in this browser and in the folder. Papers stay. A copy of how things are now is made first, so this can be undone.
saving.hist_failed: That didn’t finish. Your work may be partly back: use Put back on the newest safety copy below.
saving.safe_about: A whole copy of your work is kept in this browser before anything risky, such as bringing work in, going back in time or a new year. The newest three are kept. Papers aren’t in them, since they never change.
saving.safe_q: Put back the safety copy from {when}?
saving.safe_text: Everything goes back to how it was then, and anything added since goes. Papers stay, so a download opened since keeps its row with no marks. How things are now is kept first, so this can be undone.
saving.cf_intro: These aren’t the same in this browser and in your folder, so nothing was chosen for you. Until you decide, each place keeps its own.
saving.cf_each: Please choose a version for each one first.
saving.cf_gone: This download was forgotten, but one copy has work on it from after that.
saving.cf_setup_note: Scores stay saved either way. Totals and percents follow the one you pick.
saving.cf_rows_diff: These two copies don’t have the same rubric rows, so each shows its own.
saving.cf_one_student: A file goes to one student
saving.part_vrot: Videos turned the right way up
saving.part_carry: Flags on new and changed files
